name: Recipe Book
pitch: Recipes from any site, without the ads and life stories, and with cooking times that count the waiting.
problem: Recipe sites bury the recipe, then get the time wrong.

stats.label: minutes for tonkatsu: claimed vs. real
times per recipe: hands-on, waiting, cooking

features.title: Honest timing
features.text: Every recipe splits its time into hands-on, waiting and cooking.
details: A note flags when the source's total leaves time out
Sort the book by real total time
Waiting steps are marked, so you know when you're free

screen.alt: Tonkatsu's time chips: 25 min hands-on, 23 min waiting, 20 min cooking, and a note that the source's 30 minutes is really 1 hr 8 min

features.title: Ingredients at each step
features.text: Efficient view gives one short line per step, with its amounts right beside it.
details: No scrolling back up to check how much flour
Split into parts (sauce, breading, frying), in the order you make them
Full view keeps the source's complete instructions

screen.alt: Tonkatsu in Efficient view: numbered steps grouped by part, each with its ingredient amounts and a timer badge

features.title: Fits your kitchen
features.text: Change the servings or pan size and every amount recalculates.
details: Amounts shown as kitchen fractions, like 1/2 cup, not 0.5
US or metric, one at a time

features.title: Step timers
features.text: Tap a step's time to start a countdown.
details: They survive a reload and chime when done
Cook mode keeps the screen awake

screens.alt: Recipe Book's recipe list next to the What's cooking today? picker
screens.caption: The book, with today's suggestions
